_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "confederation" TEXT NOT NULL, "ranking" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_free_demo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_free_demo" IN (0, 1)), "primary_color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#1E88E5', "secondary_color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#FFFFFF', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "players" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES nations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "age" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" TEXT NOT NULL, "physical" INTEGER NOT NULL, "technical" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stamina" INTEGER NOT NULL, "club" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Free agent', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "careers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "manager_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES nations (id), "rng_seed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "in_game_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cycle_pointer" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_played_at" INTEGER NULL, "budget" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "captain_player_id" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "competitions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "confederation" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'worldCupQualifying', "cycle" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "qualifying_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "competition_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES competitions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_members" ("group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES qualifying_groups (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("group_id", "nation_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fixtures" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "competition_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES competitions (id), "group_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES qualifying_groups (id), "matchday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "home_nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "away_nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "home_score" INTEGER NULL, "away_score" INTEGER NULL, "played" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("played" IN (0, 1)), "round" TEXT NULL, "after_extra_time" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("after_extra_time" IN (0, 1)), "home_penalties" INTEGER NULL, "away_penalties" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tactics" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "formation" TEXT NOT NULL, "playstyle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'custom', "mentality" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "pressing" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "tempo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "width" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "defensive_line" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "directness" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lineup_slots" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "player_id" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "slot"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "call_ups" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "player_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "player_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "call_up_drafts" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "draft_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "player_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "draft_key", "player_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "training_camp_choices" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "cycle" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tournament" TEXT NOT NULL, "host_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "camp_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "cycle", "tournament"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "competition_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES competitions (id), "fixture_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES fixtures (id), "nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "player_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "minute" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "honours" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "competition" TEXT NOT NULL, "champion_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "runner_up_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "third_id" INTEGER NULL, "third_id2" INTEGER NULL, "host_id" INTEGER NULL, "final_home_score" INTEGER NULL, "final_away_score" INTEGER NULL, "top_scorer_name" TEXT NULL, "top_scorer_goals" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "draws_watched" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "cycle" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "cycle", "kind"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "player_absences" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "player_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "yellows" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "ban_matches" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "injury_matches" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "player_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rank_points" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "points" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "nation_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "seed_rankings" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "cycle" INTEGER NOT NULL, "nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rank" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "cycle", "nation_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ranking_releases" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "published_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cycle" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "player_rank" INTEGER NOT NULL, "leader_nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "published_on"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "achievements" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "achievement_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "earned_year" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "achievement_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "appearances" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "player_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "player_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tournament_appearances" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "competition_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "player_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "starts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "apps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "competition_id", "player_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "messages" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "dedup_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "read" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("read" IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE ("career_id", "dedup_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "career_stints" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "cycle" INTEGER NOT NULL, "nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "cycle"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "player_ratings" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "fixture_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES fixtures (id), "player_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rating" REAL NOT NULL, "goals" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "assists" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "clean_sheet" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("clean_sheet" IN (0, 1)), "motm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("motm" IN (0, 1)), "yellows" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "fixture_id", "player_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "federation_investments" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "cycle" INTEGER NOT NULL, "youth" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "commercial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "medical" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "naturalization" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "board_relations" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "cycle"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "match_team_stats" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "fixture_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES fixtures (id), "home_shots" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "away_shots" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "home_possession" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "home_xg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "away_xg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "fixture_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nations_cup_tiers" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tier" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "nation_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "naturalized_players" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "player_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_nation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cycle" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "player_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tactic_familiarities" ("career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "formation" TEXT NOT NULL, "familiarity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "predictability" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "last_plan_key" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("career_id", "formation"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "press_answers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "career_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES careers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "cycle" INTEGER NOT NULL, "question_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "tone" TEXT NOT NULL, "morale_delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "board_delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "answered_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
